title: Field protocol v1 collection request (core to Field)
description: The single frame core writes to a Field's standard input during a collect run, invoked as '<field-executable> collect'. It carries the negotiated protocol, the configured Field ID, non-secret configuration, an optional opaque cursor, an optional bounded window, the effective limits and deadline, the artifact staging directory, and at most a credential reference plus a protected-channel descriptor. It never carries credential material, and it never carries the notebook instance ID: producer provenance is core's, not the Field's.

protocol_revision.description: The negotiated revision, which is the minimum of the two declared revisions. Neither peer may emit a member introduced above it.

cursor.description: The last committed cursor for this Field at the manifest's declared cursor_format_version. Omitted for a first run, after a cursor reset, or when the stored cursor's format version no longer matches.

window.description: Bounded collection window. A windowed run is never a complete snapshot and can never authorize deletion by absence.

snapshot_scope.description: Present only in snapshot mode. The non-secret scope token core expects the Field to reconcile completely, so a complete run can authorize removal of absent objects inside exactly that scope and nothing wider.

config.description: Non-secret connector configuration. Flat scalars and homogeneous scalar lists only. Core never places credential material here, and a Field must not treat any value here as a secret.

credential.description: A reference, never a value. Present only when the manifest declared a credential requirement.

artifact_staging_dir.description: Absolute, core-created, core-owned, per-run directory the Field writes artifact bytes into. Core removes it when the run ends. It is not part of the notebook and a Field may write nowhere else.

allOf.description: A replayed cursor must state the format version it was produced at.
Snapshot mode must name the scope it claims to cover.

profile_ref.description: Non-secret name of the configured credential profile. Not the credential.

grant_id.description: Single-use, per-run authorization token for the protected channel. Not source credential material; it authorizes nothing outside this run's channel.

channel.description: How the Field reaches core to obtain credential material. The channel is separate from standard input, output, and error, and is closed by core when the run ends.

expires_at.description: Instant after which core refuses the grant. The Field must not cache material beyond it.
